description: This file defines the ProjectValidationEvent class used for validating and scoring various aspects of a project within the Goteo application, including methods to calculate specific scores, manage errors, and handle project validation logic.

classes.name: ProjectValidationEvent
classes.description: A class for representing validation events of projects, including scoring, error handling, and validation logic within the Goteo application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation event with a given project and resets validation scores and errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all validation scores, errors, and fields to their initial state.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys that categorize validation sections.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the current set of validation section keys.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the validation fields with errors or incomplete data.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the current validation fields with errors or incomplete data.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates validation scores for each section and computes a global score.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates the profile completeness score based on owner information.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates the overview completeness score for the project.

methods.name: getImagesScore
methods.description: Calculates the score based on project images.

methods.name: getCostsScore
methods.description: Calculates the score for the costs section of the project.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the object containing all individual scores.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the array of errors identified during validation.
